title: Dynamic Trees AFC
description: Creates dynamic versions of the trees added by AFC
body:
This mod re-envisions all of the ArborFirmaCraft trees into their Dynamic Tree counterparts within the world of TerraFirmaCraft. I adjusted some rainfall requirements for some of the AFC trees and DTTFC trees still spawn along side them. The Flame of the Forest and Red Silk Cotton trees now have orange and red leaves year-round to add diversity in the forests. The Coast Redwood is now locked behind bronze and over axes due to the large amount of logs per tree. Each tree has its own respective seed that drops. 

Required mods:
- ArborFirmaCraft by Therighthon
- TerraFirmaCraft by Dries007
- Dynamic Trees by MaxHyper
- Dynamic Trees Plus by MaxHyper
- Dynamic Trees TFC by gaelmare
- Dynamic Trees Addon Lib by Groupix05
